caseNameFull: Kosta Kisin v. State of California
summary: On petition for a writ of certiorari to the Superior Court of the State of California in and for the County of Contra Costa.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis in this case and that the clerk of this court be directed to file the petition for a writ of certiorari herein is denied. Mr. Kosta Kisin pro se.
